definitions.explanation: Not specifically identified or determined. Refers to people, things, or quantities that are not pinpointed or limited to particular individuals or items.

examples.japanese: {不特定|ふとくてい}⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is a facility used by an unspecified large number of people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不特定|ふとくてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}っていた→狙う：00313_nerau⟧。
examples.english: The criminal was targeting unspecified individuals.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不特定|ふとくてい}⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{個人情報|こじんじょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Since information is made public to an unspecified large number of people on the internet, care must be taken when handling personal information.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {不|ふ} (not) + ⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧ (specified, identified). Most commonly appears in the set phrase {不特定|ふとくてい}⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧ (unspecified large number [of people]), which is extremely common in legal, administrative, and news contexts. Functions as a noun that modifies other nouns using ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不特定|ふとくてい}⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧ (an unspecified large number of people — the most common usage)
- {不特定|ふとくてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧ (an unidentified person)
- {不特定|ふとくてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧ (an unspecified counterpart)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧: specified, identified — the opposite
- ⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧: unknown, unclear — indicates information is not available, whereas {不特定|ふとくてい} implies no attempt to specify
